answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through a stake-slashing matrix, where malicious agents are penalized for simultaneously voting and staking, effectively anchoring them to the protocol's kernel, preventing them from creating a multitude of pseudonymous identities, akin to a single entity dropping a pebble into the ocean, creating ripples that can be traced back to its harbor, thus preventing Sybil attacks.
